answer: Proposal: weight each identity by max-flow from a small set of audited anchor nodes through signed on-ledger endorsements, each endorser capped at a per-epoch budget B. Anchors form a harbor of trust; a bought bridge of endorsements into a clone farm leaves a thin cut, so one operator's many mirror keys share the same capacity instead of multiplying it. Splitting gains nothing; raising weight requires renting scarce budget from real members at a visible, slashable edge price. Assumes mostly honest anchors and public audit. Limit: anchors gatekeep; rotate them and slash careless endorsers.
